item.title: aks: Release 2026-10-25
item.description:
AKS release v20261025 adds Kubernetes 1.37 GA/LTS, makes 1.36 the default for new clusters, and ships multiple component and image upgrades. It also introduces several NAP enhancements and previews, plus notable behavior changes around automatic upgrades, Istio, AKS Automatic, etcd encryption, and VMAS-to-VMS migration.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.101
item.description:
Release v1.0.101 adds several CLI and MCP workflow fixes, including native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models, new assisted approval instructions, and more reliable sign-in and permission handling. It also fixes model selection, session resume/startup behavior, Windows/macOS shell command issues, and multiple provider-specific request and image-limit problems.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.100
item.description:
Release v1.0.100 adds new CLI flags and session/share commands, expands plugin and sandbox handling, and improves account, permission, and model management flows. It also fixes a wide range of reliability issues across MCP, Gemini, Windows, proxy, telemetry, and session browsing.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery Support for Azure ARC-enabled Windows VMWare/Physical servers
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports disaster recovery for Azure Arc-enabled Windows VMware virtual machines and on-premises physical servers. This lets customers protect Arc-managed machines with ASR while still using Azure Arc for governance and inventory.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.97
item.description:
Release v1.0.97 adds agent-scoped declarative hooks, improves plugin/MCP handling, and fixes multiple session, permissions, and UI issues. It also changes inline images to render by default on supported terminals and includes several data/output correctness fixes.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: commandline: Bringing local models and sandboxed tools to Windows and GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is adding support for deciding when to use on-device models versus cloud models on Windows. The update also mentions sandboxed tools, but no further details are provided in the excerpt.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: security: 3 lessons from frontier AI vulnerability research
item.description:
Microsoft Security says its FORGE Lab is applying frontier AI methods to scale vulnerability research beyond Windows, including work on the Linux kernel. The post highlights three takeaways from that research effort.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot can now interact with desktop apps with computer use
item.description:
GitHub Copilot computer use is now in public preview in Copilot CLI and the Copilot app on macOS and Windows. It can interact with desktop applications on the user’s behalf.

  • Source: GitHub
